//: Next.js + FastAPI monorepo — the proven stack template. Copy, then replace every <PLACEHOLDER>.
//roster: Agent/skill entries may be a bare string (name only) OR an object with owns / when / phase / required / requiredFrom. Only list agents that are ACTUALLY INSTALLED — naming a missing one makes the worker print BLOCKED and stop.
//sizing: required=true means every size. requiredFrom:'M' means only once the task spans 2+ lanes or changes a contract. This is what stops a one-line fix pulling the whole roster.

browserVerify.//: How a worker VERIFIES a user-visible change. Declare `steps` for a tool/skill-driven flow, or `recipe` for shell lines. Omit the whole block and workers get the mandate with no invented commands.
steps: Invoke the `/claude-in-chrome` skill. It handles the browser tooling — you do not need to load or name any MCP tool yourself.
Open {url} in a NEW tab — never take over a tab that is already open.
Read the page: are the values REAL, or still placeholder / mock / zero?
**Check the network requests — this is the one that matters.** A 4xx/5xx on a page that still renders numbers means a silent fallback is masking a broken call.
Take a screenshot for the PR body.

docs.//: Keeps docs true as code lands. `keyDocs` are the ones a worker must update when it changes a documented surface; `syncSkill` is an optional project skill run by a dedicated docs terminal on a loop. Omit this block entirely if the project has no docs yet — workers are then told to infer structure from the code and NOT to invent a docs tree.

parts.name: frontend
parts.testCmd: cd frontend && npx tsc --noEmit && pnpm test

agents.name: nextjs-frontend:api-route-generator-agent
agents.when: the frontend<->backend seam. A built frontend and a built backend that do not talk to each other is an INCOMPLETE task

agents.name: nextjs-frontend:supabase-integration-agent
agents.when: if queries or data access change

skills.name: frontend-design:frontend-design
skills.when: ANY UI work. NOTE the plugin namespace — the bare `frontend-design` is a different, older copy

skills.name: dataviz
skills.when: BEFORE writing any chart, graph, stat tile, KPI row, or dashboard layout

skills.name: ui-ux-pro-max
skills.when: choosing style, palette, or font pairing for new surfaces

skills.name: nextjs-frontend:design-system-enforcement
skills.when: validate every generated surface against the design schema before commit

skills.name: web-design-guidelines
skills.when: accessibility / UX audit of the built UI

agents.name: fastapi-backend:database-architect-agent
agents.when: if the schema or data model changes

agents.name: testing:test-generator
agents.when: if backend endpoints, services, or models changed

agents.name: testing:test-runner
agents.when: run the scoped suites for every lane you touched, before the PR

skills.name: testing:api-contract-testing
skills.when: the seam check: backend model == route handler == frontend fetch type. No `any`, no dead endpoints, no fabricated fallback

skills.name: testing:playwright-e2e
skills.when: user-visible flows that span frontend and backend

skills.name: testing:smoke-testing
skills.when: quick post-build sanity pass before the PR

agents.name: security:security-scanner
agents.when: if the change touches auth, secrets, user input, payments, or external API calls

skills.name: review
skills.when: pre-landing review of your full diff, immediately BEFORE you open the PR

skills.name: codex
skills.when: cross-model second opinion via `codex review` — a different model catches what this one rationalized

skills.name: simplify
skills.when: quality pass: reuse, duplication, dead code. NOT a bug hunt

skills.name: code-review:code-review
skills.when: once the PR is open — 5 parallel reviewers, confidence-scored. Fix anything scored 75+

dataFlow.//: The single strongest lever against parallel lanes inventing competing versions of the same entity. Replace with THIS project's real entities and flows.
dataFlow.notes: <invariants — who is allowed to write what>
